title: Giraffe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='16' height='42' rx='7' fill='#f2b03c'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <rect x='47' y='35' width='5' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <rect x='54' y='44' width='5' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <rect x='47' y='53' width='5' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <rect x='54' y='62' width='5' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='27' ry='15' fill='#f2b03c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='27' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ffd97a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='78' r='3.5' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='80' r='3' fill='#b06f18'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <rect x='44' y='83' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <rect x='58' y='83' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <rect x='69' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <rect x='44' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <rect x='58' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <rect x='69' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='24' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2b03c'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='28' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ffd97a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M30 32 Q34 35 39 32' stroke='#b06f18' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='44' y='13' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <rect x='50' y='14' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#e09a28'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='12' r='3' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='13' r='3' fill='#7a4a10'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='19' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e09a28' transform='rotate(-20 55 19)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='2.2' fill='#5a3410'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='21.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M77 70 Q84 68 82 78' stroke='#b06f18' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='79' r='3' fill='#7a4a10'/>
</svg>
